name: Omorphos AP
source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

defensiveAbilities.name: Pack Mentality
defensiveAbilities.description: Mental effects that target fewer than five creatures struggle to affect all of Omorphos's heads, which encourage each other to shake of the effects. Such effects gain the incapacitation trait against Omorphos.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Chorus of Baying
offensiveAbilities.description:
Omorphos's heads howl in a discordant chorus; a creature immune to other keribos' Chorus of Baying, though such creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their save. Each non-keribos within a 30ft Type:emanation takes 6d8 Mental Damage damage and must attempt a DC 23 Will Saving Throw save. After the save, the creature is temporarily immune to all Choruses of Baying for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is Frightened 2.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vicious Mauling
offensiveAbilities.description: Omorphos makes five Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward Omorphos's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they make all their attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Worry
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A Large or smaller creature is Grabbed or Restrained in Omorphos's jaws

Effect Omorphos vigorously shakes the creature and deals (2d8+10) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save). As a free action, Omorphos can throw a creature that critically fails this save up to 15 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Religion, DC 24
